thunderstorm.evaluation_note: Thunderstorm label uses TIR input as label criterion (cold anvil TIR<240K). Potential circular dependency between input and label.

cloudburst.evaluation_note: INVALID EVALUATION. Zero positive samples in test set (Aug 17-25 outside hardcoded Aug 15-18 label window). CSI/POD/F1 are NOT_MEANINGFUL. These metrics cannot be presented as evidence of cloudburst detection capability.

flash_flood.evaluation_note: INVALID EVALUATION. Flash flood label mask is STATIC across ALL test samples (exactly 158 positive pixels per sample, all identical). Model predicts this static terrain mask and achieves CSI=1.0 trivially. This is label leakage via static terrain mask, not genuine flash flood detection capability.

data_integrity_issues: Cloudburst: 0 positive pixels in test set (cloudburst label only fires Aug 15-18)
Flash flood: STATIC label mask across all 69 test samples (158/1024 pixels per sample)
Ch2 CTT rate: broadcast constant (spatial std=0)
Ch6 wind shear: broadcast constant (spatial std=0)
Ch8 moisture flux: broadcast constant (spatial std=0)
Terrain (Ch9-11): REAL data only for Wayanad; synthetic for all other locations
CAPE/CIN: surface proxy, not sounding integral
terrain_note: CartoDEM data (real) covers Wayanad only (11-12N, 75-76E). All operational locations outside this tile use procedurally synthesized terrain (not real CartoDEM).
xai_note: Attribution method is heuristic channel magnitude (mean absolute activation). NOT neural XAI (not Captum/SHAP/Integrated Gradients). Must be labeled as heuristic in all UI and documentation.
